description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams, extending FilterParams. It encapsulates filtering parameters related to employee anniversaries, including properties for the current year, next anniversary date, and minimum and maximum date differences, with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for employee anniversary search filtering parameters, supports filtering by year, next anniversary date, and date difference range.

methods.name: getThisYear
methods.description: Returns the specified year for filtering, as a string.

methods.name: setThisYear
methods.description: Sets the specified year for filtering.

methods.name: getNextDate
methods.description: Retrieves the next anniversary date as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getDateDiffMin
methods.description: Gets the minimum date difference filter value.

methods.name: setDateDiffMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum date difference filter value.

methods.name: getDateDiffMax
methods.description: Gets the maximum date difference filter value.

methods.name: setDateDiffMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum date difference filter value.
